brand.name: CHERRY
brand.about: Maker of CHERRY MX switches and keyboards, founded in 1953 in Highland Park, Illinois; CHERRY Europe GmbH is based in Auerbach in der Oberpfalz, Germany. It integrated the Swedish esports brand Xtrfy in 2022 and sells gaming boards as CHERRY XTRFY.
